description: Describe the five direct-aid programs operated by Wounded Warriors itself: (1) Emergency Financial Aid, (2) HRT Sponsorships, (3) Care Packages for Hospitalized Veterans, (4) Housing Down-Payment Assistance, (5) Community Partnerships. Use when a veteran asks what Wounded Warriors actually provides (versus the resource directory we also maintain). Returns eligibility, how-to-apply, and current intake status. Emergency-aid applications are currently paused (status:"paused").
